SUBJECT: HOUSING ASSISTANCE PAYMENTS PROGRAM – APPROVE
  WARRANT RUN AUGUST 15, 2020 – SEPTEMBER 1, 2020

Background:

The Housing Authority made payments during the period of August 15, 2020 through
September 1, 2020 for a grand total $663,455.79.

Fiscal Impact: N/A

Citizens Advised: N/A

Strategic Action Plan Implementation: N/A

Recommended Action:

Staff recommends the Housing Authority approve Check Nos. 67086-67087 & 215370 –
215376 reported on August 15, 2020 for a total of $9,388.86; and Check Nos. 67088 -
67111 & 215377 - 215538 reported on September 1, 2020 for a total of $654,066.93.

Attachments:

1. Check Summary Information Sheet
2. Check Summary
   ATTACHMENT 1
  Housing Authority
  Check Summary Information Sheet

The warrants in the Housing Authority agenda report are for housing assistance payments
made under the Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher program. The payee has a choice of
receiving the housing assistance payment via direct deposit, which is an electronic fund
transfer made directly to the payee’s bank account, or by paper check.

In the check summary report, the direct deposits are listed first as direct deposits, and then
the checks follow. Each direct deposit and paper check represents payment for 1 to 20
tenants depending upon the number of Section 8 tenants the payee has.

The payee is the property owner or designated management company. The property owner
or manager may be a corporation, partnership, trust, or individual. The payee name is the
owner or manager’s legal business or individual name, which must match Internal Revenue
Service (IRS) records. Here are some common abbreviations used in business names:

LLC = Limited Liability Company

LP = Limited Partnership

DBA = “Doing Business As”

LTD = Limited

Checks made out to the City of Norwalk Housing Authority represent the Family Self
Sufficiency (FSS) escrow deposits. These checks are deposited into the Housing Authority’s
bank account where the funds earn interest and are kept in escrow until the FSS participant
successfully completes the program at which time they receive the balance of their account.

Norwalk Housing Investors, LP is the owner of Center Pointe Villas at 14100 San Antonio
and 11856 Orange. Payments are for Section 8 participants living in these buildings.

Payments to housing authorities, such as the Orange County Housing Authority and San
Bernardino County Housing, represent reimbursements for our participants who have
transferred to those jurisdictions under portability.

Please call Nida Watkins at ext. 5653 if you have any questions.

SUBJECT: RESOLUTION NO. NHA-162 - PROPOSED ACTIVITIES FOR FISCAL
  YEAR 2020/25 AND FISCAL YEAR 2020/21 PUBLIC HOUSING AGENCY
  PLANS FOR SECTION 8 HOUSING CHOICE VOUCHER AND FAMILY
  SELF-SUFFICIENCY PROGRAMS

Background:

Housing authorities are required to complete a 5-year Public Housing Agency (PHA) plan
and an annual plan. The purpose of the plans is to advise the United States Department
of Housing and Urban Development (HUD), housing authority participants, and the
general public of the housing authority’s mission for serving the needs of low-income
families. The last 5-year plan for the Norwalk Housing Authority was adopted in 2015.

The plan presented tonight includes the 5-year plan for 2020-2025, and Fiscal Year
2020/21 Public Housing Agency Plans for Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher and Family
Self Sufficiency Programs. The plan has been prepared on HUD’s standardized template.
HUD requires that the public have 45 days to comment on the plan. The draft plan was
available for public review starting July 31, 2020.

The proposed plans include:
  • Five-year goals for the Housing Authority
  • Continued implementation of the Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher and Family
  Self Sufficiency Programs and intent to use Project-Based assistance; and
  • Progress in meeting goals described in the 2015-2020 Five Year Plan.

Fiscal Impact: N/A

   ATTACHMENT NO. 1

  RESOLUTION NO. NHA-162

  A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY OF NORWALK HOUSING AUTHORITY
  ADOPTING THE PUBLIC HOUSING AGENCY FIVE-YEAR PLAN AND
  FISCAL YEAR 2020-2021 SECTION 8 HOUSING CHOICE VOUCHER AND
  FAMILY SELF SUFFICIENCY PROGRAMS

  WHEREAS, the City of Norwalk Housing Authority has adopted the Public Housing
Agencies Five-year Plan that outlines the mission, goals and objectives of the Housing
Authority for 2020-2025; and

  WHEREAS, the City of Norwalk Housing Authority has adopted an Annual Plan that
outlines the mission, goals and objectives of the Housing Authority for Fiscal Year 2020/21;
and

  WHEREAS, the Plan is required by the United States Department of Housing and Urban
Development (HUD) of housing authorities operating the Housing Choice Voucher Program
and/or Public Housing program; and

  WHEREAS, the Plan was available for public review and comment beginning July 31,
2020; and

  WHEREAS, the Plan attached hereto as “Exhibit A” is hereby incorporated and adopted
by reference.

  NOW, THEREFORE, THE CITY OF NORWALK HOUSING AUTHORITY HEREBY
DETERMINES, FINDS, AND RESOLVES AS FOLLOWS:

  Section 1. The Public Housing Agency Five-year Plan for 2020-2025 be adopted.

  Section 2. The Public Housing Agency Annual Plan for Fiscal Year 2020/2021 be
adopted

  Section 3. Chair Jennifer Perez authorized to sign Form HUD-50077, Certifications of
Compliance with PHA Plans and Related Regulations.

  Section 4. The Chair, or presiding officer, is hereby authorized to affix her signature to
this Resolution signifying its adoption by the Norwalk Housing Authority of the City of Norwalk
and the Clerk, or her duly appointed assistant, is directed to attest thereto.

  APPROVED AND ADOPTED on this 15th day of September 2020.
